hero.title: General Surgery
hero.excerpt: The General Surgery Department at Hijaz Hospital provides comprehensive surgical care for patients requiring elective and emergency procedures. Supported by experienced surgeons, anesthetists, nursing staff, and modern operation theatre facilities, the department delivers safe, effective, and patient-centered surgical care using modern surgical techniques and evidence-based practices.

sections.heading: Overview
body: Our team manages a wide range of surgical conditions, from common general surgical procedures to complex gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary surgeries, ensuring quality care before, during, and after surgery.

sections.heading: Our Surgical Services
sections.intro: The department performs a broad range of surgical procedures, including:

groups.heading: General Surgery
items: Herniotomy and Hernia Repair (including Mesh Repair)

groups.heading: Colorectal Surgery
items: Fistula Surgery (Fistulotomy, pile, Fissure, pilonidal sinus both open& laser)

sections.heading: Why Choose Hijaz Hospital General Surgery?

items.text: Experienced general surgeons and multidisciplinary surgical team
Modern operation theatres equipped for elective and emergency surgery
Strict infection prevention and patient safety protocols
Affordable treatment with welfare support for eligible patients

sections.intro: Real recoveries from our surgical patients.

sections.heading: Help Us Keep Surgical Care Within Reach for Every Patient
sections.body: Your donation supports free treatment, medicines, and welfare programs for deserving patients — fulfilling our mission that financial hardship never stands in the way of care.
